notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Financial figures are from the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000070858-25-000139), checked against SEC XBRL; ownership is from the 2025 proxy (DEF 14A filed March 10, 2025, accession 0001193125-25-050578), shares as of March 3, 2025. LEADER: Brian Moynihan beneficially owned 2,794,827 shares (including 38,376 shared with his spouse, footnote 8); the proxy states every director and named executive owned less than 1%, so pctEconomic is null. His 1,759,727 unvested stock units are not beneficially owned under SEC rules and are not counted. HOLDERS: the proxy cites Schedule 13G/A filing dates (Berkshire February 14, 2025; Vanguard February 13, 2024; BlackRock January 29, 2024) and elsewhere says each reported more than 5% 'as of December 31, 2024'; because the footnote dates conflict with that for Vanguard and BlackRock, asOf is left null. Berkshire's 680,233,587 shares already include the 6.1% held by its subsidiary National Indemnity Company, which is not listed separately. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow statement reports one 'Cash dividends paid' line ($9,503 million) covering common and preferred; it is used as reported (the equity statement separately shows $7,822 million common and $1,613 million preferred declared). BUYBACKS: common stock only; the $5,254 million preferred stock redemption is excluded. STOCK COMP: the note's $3.6 billion compensation cost is used; the cash-flow add-back 'Amortization of stock-based compensation' is $3,433 million. GEOGRAPHY: the 'Total Non-U.S.' subtotal ($13,422 million) is omitted to avoid double counting; footnote (3) says the U.S. row 'substantially reflects the U.S.'
